basis_statement: Dead-letter posture is explicit and typed. Resolution paths distinguish safe replay, rebuild, reconcile, operator review, and terminal no-retry instead of leaving queue failure to ad hoc operations folklore.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Republish only from durable workset or outbox truth after confirming effect proof was not already persisted.
notes: Replay remains lawful because durable stage truth can prove whether the task already completed.
The broker packet itself is never the replay basis.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Persist reconciliation workflow or stronger external truth before any new authority retry is considered.
notes: Authority failures that drift binding or duplicate truth must reconcile from persisted interaction and ingress evidence.
Queue recovery must not re-send a live mutation while legality is blocked.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Open operator review with interaction, dispatch, inbox, and audit lineage attached; do not redrive automatically.
notes: Exhausted authority retry posture requires explicit review even if the broker packet still exists.
Operator review remains distinct from reconciliation-owned read-only follow-up.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Escalate the persisted reconciliation workflow with canonical ingress and response-history lineage.
notes: Read-only follow-up may stop automatically, but it must not silently vanish.
Dead-letter records still retain enough refs and hashes for investigation without raw payload dumps.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Rebuild projection dispatch from persisted manifests, receipts, and audit evidence, then retry from the rebuilt source of truth.
notes: Projection rebuild is safe because command-side truth persists independently of broker state.
Projection dead-letter never licenses mutation of manifest core.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Rebuild the delivery fabric from checkpoint, outbox, inbox, interaction, and audit truth before another recovery attempt.
notes: Recovery jobs prove rebuild posture and must never promote queue state into checkpoint truth.
A failed recovery job should surface missing durable evidence explicitly.

resolution_rows.operator_action: Preserve dead-letter evidence and stop autonomous redrive for this queue packet.
notes: Terminal posture remains explicit so broker retention does not masquerade as an active retry path.

source_lineage.rationale: Retry exhaustion, reconcile-before-retry, rebuild-before-retry, and terminal no-retry semantics.
Queue rebuild and authority resend must remain subordinate to persisted resend legality and interaction truth.
